title: Deeper/broader ft_model evidence-age and 2D comparator-readiness refresh
mode: primary-source documentation and repository-tree research only
scope: Revisit the existing ft_model candidate without creating a new peer lane
Distinguish self-reported DWG entity comparison results from independent semantic evidence
Check per-version fixture claims, test provenance, and public sample visibility
Keep optional peer work outside the fast local implementation loop

method.kind: Read-only review of public README, repository tree, version matrix, historical project status, and prior local peer receipt
method.limitations: The new repository-page observations are from mutable main and are not attributed to the previous 408e34e pin. The project reports are self-authored and were not rerun; public source pages do not provide a hash-bound DWG corpus manifest or immutable run receipt in this pass.

evidence.topic: ft_model remains a 2D parser-to-preview route, not a file writer or solid-semantic route
evidence.observed: The README describes a C++20 DWG/DXF parser feeding a SceneGraph, JSON preview export, and 2D Canvas/WebGL rendering. It does not document DWG/DXF file writing. The current public root lists test_data/fixtures but not the README-referenced test_dwg directory, and the repository page presents no release entry.
doesNotEstablish: DWG/DXF writer behavior or round-trip preservation
public availability or provenance of the README-referenced DWG sentinel files
current-main observations for previously pinned source revision 408e34e
evidence.planUse: Keep the candidate discovery-only and, at most, eligible for a conditional optional 2D preview-consumer comparison after current source/build and input provenance are pinned.

evidence.topic: The project's own current version matrix limits the advertised multi-version scope
evidence.observed: The project-authored dwg_version_deltas.md matrix lists AC1015 missing, AC1018 and AC1021 partial, AC1024 and AC1027 implemented, and AC1032 partial. This is a screening matrix, not a hash-bound test receipt.
doesNotEstablish: semantic conformance for any version family
that completion labels bind to an immutable binary, inputs, diagnostics, or expected values
evidence.planUse: Do not claim six-family validation; resolve any DWG byte-layout questions against ODA documentation and sample traces.

evidence.topic: Reported entity-match rates are historical, peer-baselined, and lossy
evidence.observed: PROJECT_STATUS.md labels itself historical/superseded and reports metrics as of 2026-04-23. It describes comparison tooling that uses LibreDWG DWG-to-DXF and ezdxf, with entity type/coordinate/property matching and spatial tolerance. It reports 42619/42698 matches for an R2010 file, 25049/25051 for R2013, 358/369 for R2007, and 1480/3913 for R2004; the same report lists mismatches and a major R2004 object-map gap.
doesNotEstablish: complete per-record identity, owner, graph, or loss accounting
writer parity, parser support promotion, or 3D support
evidence.planUse: Retain the observations as possible test-shape leads only. Any optional comparison needs exact input/build hashes, full diagnostics, an independently authored expected manifest, and separate parser/JSON/renderer outcomes.
